enum: initialize requires protocolVersion, capabilities and clientInfo

archive.description: When true, ALSO pack the backup into a single deterministic .tar (plus a .sha256 sidecar) ready for off-site placement. Default: false — the on-disk backup directory is created without an archive.

at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp the backup is created at (overrides the wall clock for deterministic testing). Default: current UTC time.

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to acknowledge the write side effects of this tool. Omitting it (or sending false) returns an { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope rather than performing the write.

backupId.description: Backup id to pack (returned by `system_backup` or visible in `system_backup_status`). When omitted, the most recent backup is selected.

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to acknowledge the write side effects of this tool. Omitting it (or sending false) returns an { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope rather than performing the write.

out.description: Optional output path for the .tar archive (default: alongside the backup directory). A .sha256 sidecar is always written next to it.

actorKind.description: Who is performing the placement: 'human' for a person clicking a button, 'agent' for an AI/automation. Default: 'agent'.

archivePath.description: Absolute path to the .tar archive produced by `system_backup` with archive:true (or `system_backup_archive`). The .sha256 sidecar is located automatically next to it.

at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp recorded in the placement log (default: current UTC time).

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to acknowledge the write side effects of this tool. Omitting it (or sending false) returns an { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope rather than performing the write.

destinationId.description: Destination id (from `system_backup_destination_list`) to copy the archive to. The destination's `location` must be a local or synced folder reachable by this process.

note.description: Optional free-text note attached to the placement record.

actorKind.description: Who performed the placement; default agent.

at.description: When the backup was placed; defaults to current UTC time and cannot be future-dated.

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to acknowledge the write side effects of this tool. Omitting it (or sending false) returns an { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope rather than performing the write.

maxMetadataAgeMs.description: Maximum acceptable provider metadata age; defaults to five minutes.

remoteObjectId.description: Provider object id of the placed archive.

backupDir.description: Path to the backup directory (or .tar archive) to restore from. ON THE MCP SERVER'S FILESYSTEM. Never modified by the restore.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to acknowledge the write side effects of this tool. Omitting it (or sending false) returns an { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope rather than performing the write.

confirmText.description: Destructive-confirmation text. Must be EXACTLY 'RESTORE <targetCompany>' — the literal word RESTORE, a space, then your targetCompany argument verbatim. Concrete example: for targetCompany='/data/acme', use confirmText='RESTORE /data/acme'. Deliberately schema-OPTIONAL (#307): a missing/empty value reaches the handler and yields the normal { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope (with code:'CONFIRMTEXT_MISMATCH'), exactly like a mismatch — never a raw -32602. Any mismatch (or omission) rejects the call.

publicKey.description: Optional path to the ASYMMETRIC ed25519 public key used to verify the backup manifest's ed25519 signature (the signature added by 'system backup --sign-with-ed25519'). Supplying it out-of-band lets an independent third party verify authenticity without the HMAC key. Distinct from verifyKey, which is the symmetric HMAC key. Mirrors the CLI's --public-key.

targetCompany.description: Path to the company directory the backup is restored INTO. Existing files here may be overwritten.

verifyKey.description: Optional path to the SYMMETRIC HMAC verification key (the '.backup-manifest.key' file) used to verify the backup manifest's HMAC tag. This is NOT the ed25519 public key — see publicKey for that. Typically required when backupDir is a .tar archive; for a backup directory still inside its company 'backups/' folder the key is otherwise inferred. Mirrors the CLI's --verify-key.

asOf.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date to evaluate the backup compliance against (default: today UTC). Use this to ask 'were we compliant on 2026-03-31?'

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp for when the destination was added (default: now).

attestedBy.description: Identity of the human making these attestations (e.g. an email). A human — not Rentemester — must attest where this backup is stored.

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to acknowledge the write side effects of this tool. Omitting it (or sending false) returns an { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope rather than performing the write.

inEeaOrEu.description: ATTESTATION (BEK 205/2024 § 4, stk. 2): true ⇒ you attest, as a human, that this destination's server is located inside the EU/EEA. Rentemester cannot determine this itself — you are legally attesting it.

itSecurityMeetsStandards.description: ATTESTATION: true ⇒ you attest, as a human, that the destination meets recognised IT-security standards. Rentemester cannot verify this itself.

itSecurityNote.description: Optional free-text note backing the IT-security attestation.

kind.description: Destination kind: 'local-folder' = a folder on this machine; 'dropbox' / 'google-drive' = a synced desktop folder of that cloud service; 'ssh' = a remote host reached over SSH; 'other' = anything else.

label.description: Human-readable name for this destination, e.g. 'Revisor Dropbox'.

location.description: Path or URI of the destination, e.g. a local folder path or an ssh:// URI.

nonRelatedParty.description: ATTESTATION: true (default) ⇒ you attest the destination is held by a non-related third party (not the company itself or a related party). Set false if the destination is a related party.

regionCountry.description: Optional ISO country code where the destination's server is located, e.g. 'DK'.

regionNote.description: Optional free-text note backing the EU/EEA region attestation.

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to acknowledge the write side effects of this tool. Omitting it (or sending false) returns an { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope rather than performing the write.

id.description: Destination id to remove. Get the id from `system_backup_destination_list`.

actorKind.description: Who performed the external placement: 'human' or 'agent'. Default: 'agent'.

archiveSha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 digest (64 chars) of the placed .tar archive. If the destination is reachable from this process, the digest is re-verified server-side before the placement is recorded.

archiveSizeBytes.description: Optional file size in bytes of the placed .tar archive. Recorded alongside the sha256 for audit.

at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp recorded in the placement log (default: current UTC time).

backupId.description: Backup id (returned by `system_backup`) the archive was produced from.

company.description: Absolute path to the company directory, or a workspace slug.

confirm.description: Must be set to true to acknowledge the write side effects of this tool. Omitting it (or sending false) returns an { ok:false, errors:[...] } envelope rather than performing the write.

destinationId.description: Destination id (from `system_backup_destination_list`) the agent placed the archive at.

note.description: Optional free-text note attached to the placement record.
